pages.text: Industrial Foregoing provides mob farming, fluid automation, and early bio-processing at Tier 2.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) T2 provides access to basic IF machines: Mob Crusher, Mob Duplicator, Animal Rancher, Plant Gatherer. These enable automated material farming.$(br2)$(bold)T3 upgrade:$(/bold) Advanced IF features (the more powerful/complex machines) are T3 content. Basic mob and plant farms are T2-accessible.
$(bold)Integration:$(/bold) IF's Fluid Crafter and Laser Drill become important for Mekanism prep at T3. Planning ahead for a Laser Drill setup in T2 is a good strategy for a T3 shortcut.
